## Purpose

Standalone walkthrough of `_targets.R`'s `disease_severity_data` target,
calling `2_preprocessing/R/functions_disease.R` directly.

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(gt)

source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_disease.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "plot_theme.R"))
```

## Step 1: Read the septoria scoring register and compute DSI

`load_disease_severity_data()` reads all four septoria scoring sheets
(A2a/A2b/B4a/B4b -- one per winter-wheat main-strip half) and calls
`calculate_dsi()` on each, which converts banded severity-percent categories
to midpoint values and computes a per-plot Disease Severity Index.

```{r load}
disease_severity_data <- load_disease_severity_data(
  here("1_input_data", "disease", "WW_sortskimmel_reg_30_07_2025.xlsx")
)
disease_severity_data
```

```{r table}
disease_severity_data |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "Winter wheat septoria DSI, 2025 season") |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = DSI_percent, decimals = 1)
```

## Step 2: DSI summary figure

```{r dsi-figure}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
plot_dsi_summary(disease_severity_data)
```
